verdict.rationale: The Agentic Feed API lets a merchant choose which AI platforms (e.g. OpenAI, Meta) each catalog item is synchronized to. That works as an implicit platform-level allow-list for catalog exposure, and marketing claims merchants stay "fully in control." There is no evidence of explicit allow/deny rules for specific agents, rate limiting, or access controls on checkout. missing for 10: per-agent allow/deny controls, rate-limiting configuration, checkout-level agent access policies, any documentation or hands-on corroboration of agent access management.
